title: Full-Stack Eval: Contracts to Pixels
objective: After this lesson you will be able to evaluate API contracts and UI states together, test reconnect/resume paths, and gate full-stack merges on combined gold with per-layer attribution.
why: Backend-green plus frontend-green still ships broken products: untested seams (stream parsing, citation rendering, resume paths) fail where neither suite looks. Full-stack gold spans the wire — API JSON asserts plus rendered-state asserts plus reconnect journeys — with failures attributed per layer (contract, stream, render, auth). Coverage ends at the user's eyes, not the API boundary.

blocks.text: Each gold conversation asserts **API layer** (status codes, entity shapes, audit entries), **stream layer** (frame order, resume equality, citation attachment), and **UI layer** (rendered states, optimistic reconciliation, empty/error designs). One run, three verdicts, per-layer owners. Layers tested in isolation plus composed end to end — isolation for speed, composition for truth.

blocks.caption: API + stream + UI expectations with forbiddens per layer

blocks.text: Drop-reconnect-resume flows get dedicated gold items: kill mid-stream (chaos or proxy), assert resume equality (final state equals uninterrupted), assert no duplicate side effects (idempotency across the drop). Mobile networks drop constantly — untested resume is untested core UX, not an edge case.

blocks.title: Score the layers
blocks.note: Run it: expect pass with [] then fail naming stream.resumed — attribution to the layer, not the stack. Fix location decided by the issue string before any code changes.

items: Gold spans API (contracts) + stream (frames/resume) + UI (rendered states) with per-layer owners
Reconnect journeys first-class: drop → resume equality → no duplicate effects
Isolation for speed, composition for truth — both suites, always

exercise.prompt: (a) Run the practice checker on both runs and map verdicts. (b) Add a UI-layer failure (citations 0 vs expected 2) and confirm attribution names ui.citations. (c) Write the reconnect gold item (drop at 50%, resume, equality + idempotency asserts) in the Ch.6 shape.
hints: Verdicts: pass [] / fail [stream.resumed] — owner named, fix located in resume path.
UI failure: citations 0 → [ui.citations] — rendering layer indicted, API exonerated.
Reconnect gold: flow with drop step, expect resumed-equal + no-duplicate-effects, forbid restart-from-zero.
exercise.why: Layer attribution (API/stream/UI owners), reconnect gold (drop discipline), and forbidden shapes (restart/uncited) are the three full-stack eval judgments.
exercise.code: // Layered-gold pattern: per-layer expects + forbiddens + reconnect journeys.

quiz.q: API green, UI shows stale drafts. Missing layer?
options: UI-state gold (rendered states, stream parsing, resume paths) — full-stack truth ends at pixels
quiz.explain: Backend truth ≠ product truth: rendering, parsing, and resume paths live untested between suites. Layered gold covers the wire end to end.

options: Core UX untested: mobile drops constantly — reconnect journeys are first-class gold, not curiosities
quiz.explain: Drop frequency on mobile makes resume a main path. Untested resume fails exactly where users live.

quiz.q: Correct terminal, wrong citations count. Fault bin + owner?
options: UI/rendering layer (citation attach) — terminal correctness exonerates routing; count mismatch indicts render
quiz.explain: Layer attribution: terminal right (routing/state fine), count wrong (rendering/attach fault). Fix location from the issue string.

summary: API + stream + UI gold with per-layer owners, reconnect journeys first-class, forbiddens per layer. Full-stack truth ends at the user's eyes.
next: Proven across layers — now the launch itself: evidence, gates, and residual risks. Next and last: the ship review.
